observed_chain: One whole policy only: object-clocked habitat occupancy plus local density selects a direct one-Cat attempt, with strict village-before-hut precedence. Village and hut conditions, cosmetic variants, scheduler/helpers/counters/raw tags are one parameterized family, not separate credits.

Native startup constructs CatSpawner in ordinary overworld custom-spawner list; source constructor stores passed list. Other dimensions in studied startup receive empty list. ServerChunkCache invokes level.tickCustomSpawners with spawnEnemies/spawnFriendlies after ordinary natural-spawn loop in its guarded chunk tick path; custom spawner does not receive SpawnState/category counts or the400-tick creature flag. Full server/hook dispatch and actual cap are not certified; no universal bypass claim.

CatSpawner requires friendly boolean and RULE_DOMOBSPAWNING, then predecrements nextTick. Fresh object int0 is eligible immediately, resets1200 before all random-player, terrain, quota and factory/admission failures. Disabled calls do not decrement. Source class contains no own persistence/load method;1200 means delivered eligible custom calls, not guaranteed wall/world time and not durable saved opportunity. Host custom-spawner caller ignores returned count.

getRandomPlayer uses getPlayers(LivingEntity::isAlive), then uniform index over this current list. The shown overload loops current level players with only passed predicate; no explicit spectator/creative filter. Candidate takes selected player BlockPos and independent signed8..31 offsets in X/Z, same block Y; one candidate, no heightmap or retry/Y search here. No claim all players are alive/non-spectating or terrain suitable.

Before habitat quota, hasChunksAt checks candidate XZ±10 and ON_GROUND NaturalSpawner.isSpawnPositionOk for CAT. Ground helper checks world border/below valid-spawn block and body/above empty guards including collision-full, signal source, nonempty fluid, PREVENT_MOB_SPAWNING_INSIDE and type danger. This does not call registered Cat spawn predicate or prove full-entity bbox/light/path safety. Candidate region check is not whole48-radius POI/structure no-load guarantee.

If isCloseToVillage(candidate,2) then returns spawnInVillage result directly, including0; only else tests CATS_SPAWN_IN valid piece and hut. No hut fallback after failed village HOME/density quota. isCloseToVillage uses section-based occupied VILLAGE POI distance tracker, not literal two-block/32-block or exactly five beds proximity. Native base VILLAGE raw tag includes nested acquirable_job_site, HOME and meeting; nested tag and loaded registry composition unexpanded.

Village uses count>4 HOME POI records with Occupancy.IS_OCCUPIED and actual3D BlockPos squared distance<=48². HOME bootstrap enumerates HEAD states for16 bed colors with maxTickets1; not counting every bed block, raw placed beds, all village residents or five proven distinct/live villagers. Occupancy is freeTickets!=maxTickets; codec free_tickets defaults0 and no integer bounds here. Loaded inconsistent/excess/negative free-ticket values do not prove real owners or current reservations.

PoiManager getInSquare scans larger chunk ring then getInRange applies sphere; getInChunk getOrLoad across vertical sections, PoiSection byType predicate then occupancy test. Hence query can touch POI storage beyond checked±10 region; no complete SectionStorage IO/repair/load/unload, vanilla villager acquire/release or contention audit. This is a read quota, no reservation/acquire/atomic spawn commit in CatSpawner.

Village Cats list size<5 uses new AABB(unit BlockPos).inflate(48,8,48); hut threshold<1 uses inflate(16,8,16). Boxes differ from spherical48 HOME range and section village distance. Own code/default getEntitiesOfClass uses NO_SPECTATORS, no explicit tame/owner/alive/radial/LOS predicate. Native Level query applies passed predicate over backend and part query; full backend visibility/concurrency not read. Do not call this dimension-global cap or guaranteed live-wild-cat count.

Hut requires getStructureWithPieceAt for registry tag CATS_SPAWN_IN with valid start. StructureManager resolves chunk reference/start data, filters tagged structures/valid nonempty starts and actual component bbox containing candidate, not only structure overall bbox. Both native base cats_spawn_in and cats_spawn_as_black raw tags list swamp_hut, but loaded datapack tags/current world structures unverified and shared identical bytes earn0.

spawnCat calls nullable EntityType.CAT.create; actual registration uses Cat factory/CREATURE dimensions, enabled feature check can returnnull. Nonnull moves to candidate BEFORE Cat.finalizeSpawn with NATURAL/null data, then void addFreshEntityWithPassengers and returns1. No explicit checkSpawnRules(instance), checkSpawnObstruction/full bbox, current biome spawn table or category budget in this own helper. Generic NATURAL reason alone is not ordinary NaturalSpawner success.

ServerLevelAccessor helper invokes addFreshEntity for self/passengers without checking its boolean. Reused exact prior own ServerLevel/PersistentEntitySectionManager source shows removed rejection, cancelable EntityJoinLevelEvent and duplicate UUID rejection. CatSpawner still returns1 after normal void helper return; it is requested attempt count, not accepted-birth/native population proof. No new UUID persistence or accepted receipt is stored by spawner.

Cat.finalizeSpawn chooses variant from full-moon tag only if moonbrightness>0.9, otherwise default tag, setting random holder if present; at moved position valid CATS_SPAWN_AS_BLACK piece overrides ALL_BLACK and persistenceRequired, then super. Raw base default contains10 variants, full-moon adds all_black via nested default; cosmetic selections0, not generated new models/textures or guarantee loaded membership. Mob persistence setter only flag, not admission/despawn immunity proof.

Bounded AgeableMob group finalization sees null→fresh group, groupSize>0 baby condition, increments group then delegates; Mob.finalizeSpawn random follow-range/hand and spawnType assignment. Full inheritance/Forge transformation/attributes, client, eventual ticking, tame/owner persistence, death/drop and save/reload remain unexpanded; do not convert partial superclass source into blanket adult/owner/current-world guarantee.

Existing Cat/Wolf paid collar and legacy ocelot-to-cat/trust migration whole rows retain their accepted ownership; this source proposal adds0 global/migration credit. Named full-ledger scan finds no literal CatSpawner/spawnInVillage/spawnInHut owner, but a name scan is not independent semantic novelty proof. Distinct Main complete-chain review is required before any formal ID/package or ecology count.
